events.n: chromist; lithograph created after the original work
events.q: The lithographs were meticulously created after the original works oil paintings watercolors pastels and charcoal drawings by Master Chromist Marcel Salinas

events.n: publisher, in conjunction with Jackie Fine Arts; printed by Marcel Salinas
events.q: Published by the Estate of Picasso (Marina Picasso) in conjunction with Jackie Fine Arts and printed by Chromist Marcel Salinas

events.n: printing authorized by Picasso's granddaughter after his death; known as the Picasso Estate Collection
events.q: After Pablo Picasso's death, his granddaughter Marina authorized the printing of these original lithographs which have come to be known as the Picasso Estate Collection
